newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche up with market after profits.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche up with market after profits.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Bank AG were up in line with the overall market on Wednesday after the company announced that group pre-tax profit climbed to 4.9 billion marks in 1996 from 3.6 billion marks the year before.
At 1103 GMT, Deutsche's share price was up 1.75 percent to 93.67 while the 30-share DAX index was 1.81 percent higher at 3,409.74.
Traders said Deutsche's gains were in line with a broader advance in the German banking sector and that figures it released on Wednesday were in line with expectations.
Deutsche had also said that it expected improved overall profit in 1997 and that its business development in the first three months of the year confirmed that expectation.
